## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `build:`, `ci:`, `test:`, `refactor:`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `flutter test` passes
- [ ] No hardcoded user facing strings (English and Bengali ARB entries added)
- [ ] No user content (chats, prompts, file names) written to logs
- [ ] New dependency? Pinned exact version, listed in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md with license
